analysis.title: FSA Fixed Income Daily Commentary 24 November 2026
key_insights: Treasuries bear-flattened Monday. 2Y rose 4.5bps to 4.695% on a hawkish NY Fed Williams and a risk-on Nvidia rally, 10Y flat at 4.946%, 30Y down 2.3bps to 5.308%. A solid $69bn 2Y auction at 4.70% capped the selloff.
Fed is expected to hike for the second time this year at the December 8-9 meeting. Williams said there is still 'work to do' on inflation that continues to run too high.

Mixed global PMIs. US flash manufacturing 53.7 vs 54.5 prior and services 54.7 vs 56.1 prior. Germany composite 55.0 vs 53.2 expected, highest since March 2022. France composite 46.2 vs 47.9 expected. UK composite 52.3 vs 52.9 in October.

Braskem reportedly reached a USD4.9bn restructuring deal with creditors: USD1.3bn Petrobras equity plus USD3.6bn debt-to-equity conversion, leaving about USD7bn debt. Formal confirmation and judicial approval are pending. FSA stays MP and sees possible bond opportunities depending on recovery values.

NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Nov 23 after his Nov 11 resignation, viewed as credit positive. 3Q FY27 FCF was USD43,777m, 4Q FY27 revenue guide is USD130bn +/-3%, and guarantee exposure is USD118bn. Moody's moved the outlook to stable from positive on Nov 18.

HPE 4Q FY2026 revenue was USD14.55bn, up 50.3% YoY, with net debt down to USD12.9bn and FY2027 revenue guide of USD59.4-63.1bn. Inventory more than doubled to USD14.09bn, a working-capital watch item. MP maintained.
HK & China Gas was downgraded to A2 by Moody's (outlook stable) on weaker financial metrics. Equity raise and disposal timing is uncertain. FSA stays MP.

Petrobras 2027-2031 plan raises investment to USD122bn, keeps a USD75bn gross debt ceiling with a target near USD65bn. Brent assumed at USD74 in 2027 and USD70 thereafter. The risk is Brent below plan or start-up slippage.

Rating agency actions this day: S&P moved Sasol outlook to stable from negative (BB+ affirmed). S&P moved Ulker outlook to negative (BB affirmed). Lendlease was judged credit negative, with gearing of 30.3% vs a 5-15% target and negative outlooks at Moody's and Fitch.

Pertamina: S&P sees 2026 EBITDA of USD13-14bn, with USD9.6bn of subsidy compensation receivables as the key working-capital issue. FSA sees better value in the 2030/2042 bonds and says a downgrade is priced in.

AT1/tender activity: HSBC accepted USD1.5bn of its USD3bn 6.000% CoCo at 100.5% (proration 93.28%) and funded via a new 7.625% perp, which FSA recommended switching into. Rabobank accepted EUR1bn at 113% (scaling 69.86%), and FSA recommended rejecting, expecting a higher-priced tender within 2 years.

Other credit updates: ABB acquisition of Ziehl-Abegg at USD2.65bn EV is credit neutral. Drax raised its 2029 EBITDA target and its leverage target to about 2.5x (neutral). Tata Steel's APL Apollo deal is slightly credit positive. Raizen restructuring is credit positive. Bancolombia, Julius Baer (prefers 2031 EUR bonds), KEB Hana and BMS CFO change (neutral) all stay MP.

Cross-asset performance table shows sharp drawdowns. Nasdaq -5.28% over 1D (table column), S&P 500 -3.69% 1D, and precious metals deeply negative YTD (silver -39.04%, gold -15.53%). WTI is +41.38% YTD.

market_movers.rationale: Reinstatement of CEO Huang is credit positive, with strong FCF and net cash. Investigation and government inquiries remain open. Credit view MP.
Higher earnings, cash generation and lower leverage improve debt service capacity after Juniper. Inventory build is a watch item. Credit MP.
CFO transition with FY2026 guidance reaffirmed is broadly neutral for bondholders.
Tender for 6.000% CoCo oversubscribed. FSA had recommended accepting and switching into the new 7.625% perp NC 2031.
Hong Kong & China Gas was downgraded by Moody's to A2 on weaker metrics. FSA credit view remains MP.
Rabobank AT1 certificates: FSA recommended rejecting the 113% tender and holding the 6.5% fixed-for-life coupon.

sector_views.rationale: Issuer views mostly MP with selective value, such as Pertamina 2030/2042 bonds and Braskem recoveries.
Tender offers give mixed outcomes. Accept HSBC switch, reject Rabobank at 113%.

earnings_insights: HPE 4Q FY2026 reported revenue USD14.55bn (+50.3% YoY), GAAP diluted EPS USD1.26 vs USD0.11, adjusted operating margin 16.9%. FY2027 guidance is revenue USD59.4-63.1bn and at least USD5.5bn FCF.
NVIDIA 3Q FY27 reported revenue USD115.8bn with data center USD108bn and FCF USD43,777m. Company guided 4Q FY27 revenue USD130.0bn +/-3% and FY28 growth about 75%.
Bancolombia/Grupo Cibest 3Q26 reported net income COP2.08tn, -23.8% QoQ and -3.0% YoY. NIM 7.43%. 2026 guidance NIM 7.4-7.6%, cost of risk 1.6-1.8%.
Julius Baer 10M26 adjusted pre-tax profit reported at a record CHF1.3bn (+17% underlying). Net new money growth 2.0% annualised. Management guides 2027 cost/income slightly above 67%.
ABB 3Q26 reported orders USD12,055m (+40%), revenue USD9,701m (+14%), Operational EBITA USD2,026m (20.8% margin).
Braskem Q3 reported recurring EBITDA USD382m, -63% QoQ and +154% YoY. Leverage 6.36x vs 6.74x.
HK & China Gas 1H26 reported revenue HK$29.53bn (+7.3% YoY), attributable profit HK$3.64bn (+23%).
Drax said 2026 Adjusted EBITDA will be significantly above consensus estimate of GBP721m.
BMS FY2026 non-GAAP guidance (raised Oct 29): revenue $49.75-50.25bn and EPS $6.35-6.55, reaffirmed Nov 23.
Ulker 9M 2026 reported revenue -8.8% after IAS 29, EBITDA margin 11.6% vs 17.8%. HKCG first-half is reported.
Pertamina 1H26 reported revenue $42.3bn (+24% YoY), EBITDA $6.7bn, net profit $1.9bn.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Front-end sold off on hawkish Fed remarks, +4.6bps.
Highest since March 2022, supports ECB growth optimism.
Contraction deepening on election and budget uncertainty.

macro_indicators.reading: Second hike of the year expected at Dec 8-9 meeting
macro_indicators.interpretation: Markets price hike risk slightly higher after Williams.

trade_ideas.description: Accept HSBC 6.000% CoCo tender and switch into new HSBC 7.625% perp NC 2031
trade_ideas.rationale: Modest premium to par and refinancing into higher coupon new perp.

trade_ideas.description: Reject Rabobank AT1 certificate tender at 113% and hold the 6.5% fixed-for-life coupon
trade_ideas.rationale: YTP of 5.88% remains attractive in EUR and a higher-priced tender is likely within 2 years.

trade_ideas.risk: Sovereign rating risk and government compensation delays.
Weak organic inflows and shareholder distributions.

risk_factors: Hawkish Fed with a second hike expected Dec 8-9.
Braskem restructuring lacks formal confirmation and creditor support, and residual debt of about USD7bn is high.
Brent falling below Petrobras plan assumptions or project delays.
NVIDIA investigation and guarantee exposure of USD118bn.
Turkish inflation of about 30% and weak demand pressure Ulker.
Lendlease gearing above target and MSG North funding gap of about AUD160m.
Capital upstreaming and shareholder distributions at banks (KEB Hana, Cibest, Julius Baer).
vol_and_positioning: Nasdaq -5.28% 1D and S&P 500 -3.69% 1D per the performance table, while the text describes an Nvidia-driven risk-on rally, an inconsistency not reconciled in the report.
Oversubscribed AT1/CoCo tenders (HSBC proration 93.28%, Rabobank 69.86%) signal strong demand for exits.
geopolitical: Elevated Brent driven by geopolitical risk around the Strait of Hormuz and the Middle East, cited by S&P in the Sasol update.
Middle East war-related demand and cost pressure across MENA cited as a headwind for Ulker.
France private sector contraction weighed by election uncertainty and budget concerns.
NVIDIA investigation into a reported foreign intelligence effort targeting Huang, with government input on national security.
cross_bank_references: Moody's downgraded HK & China Gas to A2, outlook stable.
S&P revised Sasol outlook to stable from negative and Ulker outlook to negative.
Moody's changed NVIDIA Aa1 outlook to stable from positive on Nov 18.
